US012 - Add new role

As an Admin
I want to add a new role to an existing capability and band
So that I can keep the software information up to date
Acceptance criteria
Able to add a new role to an existing band and capability
Able to add details to new role:
Job role name
Job spec summary
Sharepoint link
Responsibilities
Number of open positions
Location
closing date
Able to select band from dropdown of bands in database
Able to select capability from dropdown on capabilities in database
Input data must be validated on UI & API
Able to create a role from the job roles list page
Status should be set to "open" in database

US020 - Delete a role

As an Admin
I want to delete a role
So that I can keep the software information up to date
Acceptance criteria
Able to delete the role from the job roles list page and the job specification page
Warning must appear asking for confirmation before deletion

US015 - Edit a role

As an Admin
I want to edit a role
So that I can keep the software information up to date
Acceptance criteria
Able to update:
Job role name
Job description
Sharepoint link
Responsibilities
Band (dropdown list)
Capability (dropdown list)
Status (dropdown list)
Number of open positions
Location
closing date
UI must pre-populate fields in form
Input data must be validated in UI & API
Able to edit the role from the job roles list page and the job specification page
